Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer misread or prematurely accepted the FR Wikipedia page snippet as saying André Beaunier was born in Paris, contradicting earlier results and later confirmations that list Évreux. This overreliance on a single (and likely mis-rendered) viewport snippet without immediate cross-verification led to the incorrect birthplace assumption.
